auth.invalidToken: That token is invalid or the UI session has expired.
auth.tokenUrlMissing: This URL does not contain a token parameter.
auth.tokenHelpTitle: Get the token from the CLI
auth.tokenHelpDescription: Open another terminal in the project and run:
auth.demoPublic: Explore the public UI demo without a token.

layout.homeDescription: View the local workspace overview and shortcuts.
layout.skillsDescription: Discover and manage reusable capabilities for local Agents.
layout.themeDescription: Adjust the shared accent and interface appearance.
layout.settingsDescription: Manage platforms, backups, language, and revisions.
layout.demoDescription: Open the public component and design specimen lab.

portal.title: Choose where to begin.
portal.description: Three paths, one shared workspace. Shape capabilities, tune the atmosphere, or manage the system beneath it all.
portal.skillsDescription: Discover, organize, and connect reusable capabilities across every local Agent.
portal.themeDescription: Tune color, contrast, and motion until the workspace feels unmistakably yours.
portal.settingsDescription: Control platforms, backups, language, and the shared configuration revision.

workspace.skillsPageDescription: A focused view of the reusable capabilities shared by every enabled Agent.
workspace.themePageDescription: Choose a shared accent color, then preview the light and dark appearance locally.
workspace.themeMistDescription: Bright surfaces, cyan energy and generous clarity.
workspace.themeNightDescription: A focused dark canvas with luminous details.
workspace.themeSystemDescription: Match the appearance preference of this device.
workspace.themeColorDescription: This accent is shared by the Web and CLI.
workspace.themeRoseDescription: Expressive warmth with a precise edge.
workspace.pageTitle: One workspace for every local agent.
workspace.pageDescription: Manage shared settings, platform connections, and Skills topology from a calm, versioned control surface.
workspace.settingsDescription: Changes are stored in ~/.askx/config.json and synchronized with the CLI.
workspace.platformsDescription: Choose the local agents managed by this workspace.
workspace.backupDescription: Keep a durable copy before AskAgent X changes a platform link.
workspace.languageDescription: This preference is shared by the Web and CLI and is saved immediately.
workspace.syncDescription: The Web watches the same revision used by every CLI command.
workspace.skillsDescription: Read-only discovery is available now. Transactional changes unlock after the safety chain is complete.
workspace.feedbackMinPlatform: Keep at least one Agent platform
workspace.feedbackSaveFailed: Failed to save settings; try again
workspace.feedbackReset: All shared settings were restored to defaults (revision #{revision}).
workspace.resetSettingsDescription: Reset language, theme, platform selection and the backup option.
workspace.resetSettingsConfirmDescription: The current shared settings will be replaced with defaults and saved as a new revision.
workspace.resetSettingsPreserved: Skills, the canonical source, backups, managed links and transaction history are preserved.

skills.title: Connect your local Skills.
skills.description: Choose the Agents to manage, then let AskX scan local capabilities read-only. Scanning and adjustment only record pending changes; files change only when you save the final processing results.
skills.platformDescription: AskX scans selected platform directories and custom folders read-only to discover Skills. A later, separate step decides whether each platform's whole Skills directory should link to the canonical source.
skills.customFolderDescription: Save up to {max} directories. Choose either an individual Skill directory or a parent containing several Skills. They use the same read-only scanner as platform presets and never modify the originals.
skills.noCustomFolders: Optional: no extra folders added. AskX will scan only the Agent platforms selected above.
skills.folderSelectionFailed: AskX could not open or read the local directories. Choose them again.
skills.scanDescription: AskX merged same-name copies across platforms and selected safe defaults. This step only records each Skill's pending change and does not modify local files or symlinks; AskX applies them only when you save the processing results in the final step.
skills.finalSkillListDescription: Each row is one merged Skill. The current selection is only recorded as a pending change to be saved later.
skills.decisionSelectDescription: The current selection is only recorded as pending and does not modify local files immediately.
skills.noMatchingSkillsDescription: Try another search term or filter.
skills.noSkillDescription: This Skill does not provide a description.
skills.fullDescriptionHint: Read the complete description provided in this Skill's metadata.
skills.linkSelectionDescription: This step only chooses which platforms or custom directories use the AskX canonical source through a symlink. It does not scan or collect Skills again. Sources chosen in step one are selected by default, and you may add other usage targets.
skills.linkSelectionItemReady: When configuration is saved, AskX backs up the original directory before creating the whole-directory symlink.
skills.linkSelectionItemBlocked: The current path state cannot be linked and remains a read-only scan source.
skills.linkSelectionItemSource: This was a collection source in step one and is selected by default as a Skill usage target.
skills.linkSelectionItemAdditional: Additional usage platform. Selecting it configures only the symlink and does not scan its Skills.
skills.linkCustomFolderDescription: Configure up to {max} symlink usage directories. Folders chosen in step one are included by default; folders added here are usage targets only and are not scanned.
skills.linkNoCustomFolders: No custom symlink usage directories are selected. You may add one without triggering another scan.
skills.linkSelectedCount: Symlinks will be configured for {platformCount} platforms and {directoryCount} custom directories.
skills.linkSkippedHint: No platform link will be created. Skills are only added to the AskX canonical source.
skills.syncPlatformSkillsTip: Scan this platform and sync its Skills into the AskX canonical source without changing the platform directory or link state.
skills.syncDialogDescription: Scan this platform read-only and write confirmed Skills into the AskX canonical source without changing the platform directory or symlink state.
skills.syncScanDescription: AskX compared this platform with the canonical source read-only. Selections here are only pending; saving updates the AskX canonical source while leaving the platform directory and symlink state unchanged.
skills.syncConfirmDescription: This save only updates the AskX canonical Skill source after staging and verification. It never changes the platform directory or creates, suspends, or restores a platform symlink.
skills.syncPlanTitle: Sync only into the AskX canonical source
skills.syncPlanDescription: The current platform is a read-only source. Its Skills directory and existing symlink relationship are not part of this action plan.
skills.syncOperationKeep: Keep the current AskX canonical version and do not sync this Skill from the platform
skills.syncOperationSelectSource: Use this read-only source to update the AskX canonical source: {path}
skills.syncOperationReplace: Use the selected version to update the AskX canonical source: {path}
skills.noSyncFilesDescription: No Skills were found on this platform. The AskX canonical source, platform directory, and symlink state remain unchanged.
skills.syncApplying: Validating and updating the canonical source…
skills.syncResultDescription: The selected Skills were written and verified in the AskX canonical source. The platform directory and symlink state were not changed.
skills.syncNoChanges: This platform had no Skills to write into the canonical source, so nothing changed.
skills.platformEmpty: No Skills found on this platform
skills.adoptResult: This only records the item as “Adopt”. On final save, AskX writes the Skill to the canonical source, which platforms access through their whole Skills directory proxy.
skills.mergeResult: This only records the item as “Merge”. On final save, AskX consolidates identical copies into one Skill in the canonical source.
skills.keepResult: This only records the item as “Do not import”. The Skill does not enter the new canonical source; its original platform Skills directory is retained as a restorable whole-directory backup.
skills.replaceResult: This only records the item as “Use this version”. On final save, AskX writes the selected version into the canonical source and backs up the original platform directory as a whole.
skills.renameResult: This only records the item as “Rename and adopt”. On final save, AskX writes the content into the canonical source under the new name.
skills.archiveResult: This only records the item as “Delete (recoverable)”. AskX moves selected copies into backups only when you save the processing results in the final step; nothing is physically deleted.
skills.archiveHint: Original content moves into AskX backups and is never physically deleted.
skills.chooseArchiveCopies: Choose copies to move into backup
skills.confirmDescription: Review the platforms and custom directories that will use the AskX canonical source through symlinks, plus the Skills entering that source. Files change only after you save, and every usage target is backed up and verified independently.
skills.confirmPlatformsDescription: After saving, the platforms and custom directories below point to the AskX canonical source.
skills.confirmNoPlatforms: No symlink usage target is configured. Selected Skills are saved only to the canonical source.
skills.confirmSkillsDescription: These Skills enter the AskX canonical source when the configuration is saved.
skills.operationKeep: Do not import; retain the original in the whole platform-directory backup
skills.operationArchive: Do not import; retain this path in the platform-directory backup: {path}
skills.operationReplace: Use this version; retain the original in the whole platform-directory backup: {path}
skills.noFilesDescription: No Skills were found to add. AskX only saves the selected sources; platform directories are touched only when explicitly chosen in the link step.
skills.applying: Building the canonical source and switching platform directories…
skills.resultDescription: The canonical source is built and verified, and each selected platform or custom directory now connects to the same source.
skills.resultPartialTitle: Canonical source saved; some symlink targets failed
skills.resultPartialDescription: Successful targets are using the canonical source. Failed targets were restored and recorded without affecting the others.
skills.rootBindingDescription: Each platform receives one directory-level symlink and is connected as an independent sub-transaction. One platform failure does not affect the others.
skills.emptyCanonicalConnected: The canonical source is empty, and the selected platform Skills directories are connected. Add Skills directly to the canonical source.
skills.managerDescription: Manage local Skills from one canonical directory and point each selected Agent's whole Skills directory to it—maintain once, reuse everywhere.
skills.listDescription: Managed Skills and unmanaged copies found locally are listed together here.
skills.resourceDescription: Browse Skills in the canonical source, inspect versions, descriptions and full file structures, and maintain content through a protected update flow.
skills.statsDescription: Statistics come only from explicit records in the local Registry. AskX does not monitor Agents or upload data.
skills.statsRankingDescription: Sorted by locally recorded explicit usage from highest to lowest.
skills.statsEmpty: No Skills have been added to version management yet.
skills.statsLoadFailed: Skill statistics are unavailable. Repair the built-in Skill Manager first.
skills.statsUnavailableTitle: Version and usage statistics are unavailable
skills.statsUnavailableDescription: AskX Skill Manager or its local Registry needs repair. Complete the confirmed repair, then reload statistics.
skills.managedSkillsDescription: Saving writes version metadata and the management declaration, then registers the Skill in the Registry without changing its directory or symlinks.
skills.unmanagedSkillsDescription: Saving removes version metadata, the management declaration, and Registry statistics while keeping all other files, directories, and symlinks unchanged.
skills.noManagedSkills: No Skills are managed by AskX yet.
skills.addManagementTitle: Add this Skill to version management?
skills.addManagementDescription: AskX writes version metadata and its managed declaration in a protected transaction, then registers the Skill locally.
skills.removeManagementDescription: Only AskX version metadata, its managed declaration, and Registry entry are removed. Skill content and platform links are unchanged.
skills.removeManagementWarning: The Skill's version, explicit usage, and target statistics will be removed from the Registry. Skill files and platform access remain unchanged.
skills.managementAdded: The Skill is now managed by AskX.
skills.managementRemoved: Version management was removed. Skill content and links were unchanged.
skills.managementActionFailed: The management update failed. Existing content was preserved or restored.
skills.managementScopeDescription: Choose which Skills AskX tracks for versions, explicit usage, and sync status. Moving items only changes the draft; processing starts after save.
skills.managementDraftDescription: Moving Skills between lists does not modify files immediately. Review all choices, then save once to process them as a batch.
skills.managementBatchPartial: Batch completed: {success} succeeded and {failed} failed. Failed Skills were left unchanged.
skills.localSkillsDescription: These Skills stay on this device and are excluded from platform links and exports.
skills.localMigrationConfirmDescription: AskX backs up the local copy, writes it to the shared canonical source, and updates the Registry. Failures restore the original state.
skills.localMigrationCompleted: The local Skill was moved to the shared canonical source.
skills.localMigrationFailed: The local Skill migration failed. Original content was preserved.
skills.systemRepairDescription: The built-in system Skill is missing, corrupt, or outdated. Version updates, usage, and sync statistics remain unavailable until repaired.
skills.systemRepairPreserve: The current Registry is valid and its versions, usage, and sync statistics will be preserved.
skills.systemRepairUsageWarning: No valid Registry was found, so previous usage and sync statistics cannot be restored.
skills.systemRepairFailed: AskX Skill Manager repair failed. Existing data was not changed.
skills.systemRepairLoadFailedTitle: Unable to create a repair plan
skills.systemRepairLoadFailedDescription: The built-in asset or current state is temporarily unavailable. Reload the plan; no repair or data change can occur until it succeeds.

systemHealth.outdated: Built-in Skill Manager needs an update

skills.copyManagerTip: Export canonical Skills as independent copies. Exported copies do not follow later canonical updates automatically.
skills.copyManagerDescription: Export canonical Skills as independent copies in platforms or local folders. Selection and review never modify files.
skills.copySelectSkillsDescription: Select one or more Skills from the canonical source, then export them to multiple platforms or local folders.
skills.copySelectTargetsDescription: Platforms and local folders can be selected together. Platforms already using the canonical root symlink stay current and need no independent export.
skills.copyFolderTargetsDescription: Choose multiple directories at once. Each receives same-name child directories for the selected Skills.
skills.copyTargetLimit: Choose at most {count} export locations at once.
skills.copyReviewDescription: This step only records decisions and does not modify files. For a same-name Skill with different content, choose whether to keep the target or replace it with a backup. Copying starts only after Start export is clicked.
skills.copyConflictsDescription: Each row is one independent Skill and target conflict. Replacements create a verified full backup first.
skills.copyIdentityConflict: The same-name Skills have different identities. You must choose explicitly; AskX will not overwrite automatically.
skills.copySourceNewer: Canonical version {source} is newer than target {target}; upgrading the target is preselected.
skills.copySourceOlder: Canonical version {source} is older than target {target}; keeping the target is preselected. Replacing it is an explicit downgrade.
skills.copySameVersionDifferentContent: Both sides report version {version}, but their business content differs. Choose explicitly.
skills.copyUnknownVersionConflict: Version information is incomplete or the target is unmanaged. Review the content and choose explicitly.
skills.copyNoConflictsTitle: No same-name conflicts need a decision
skills.copyNoConflictsDescription: Missing Skills copy after final confirmation, while identical targets are skipped automatically.
skills.copyUnresolvedConflicts: {count} same-name conflicts still need a decision.
skills.copyDialogDescription: Export this canonical Skill as an independent copy in a platform or local folder. This does not create a symlink or modify the source.
skills.copyAlreadyLinked: Already using the canonical source link
skills.copyChooseFolderDescription: The selected directory is the Skill container; AskX writes a same-name child directory inside it.
skills.copyChooseSingleFolder: Choose exactly one export folder and try again.
skills.copyConflictDescription: AskX keeps the target by default. Replacing first copies the original directory into AskX backups, verifies it, then atomically switches versions.
skills.copyKeepTargetDescription: Write nothing and record this export as skipped.
skills.copyReplaceTargetDescription: Preserve the target, then replace it with the canonical version.
skills.copyBackupHint: AskX creates and verifies a complete backup first. A failed write or receipt save restores the original directory automatically.
skills.copyVerifyHint: Content is written to same-filesystem staging, fingerprinted, then moved into the final path.
skills.copyIdenticalHint: The target already matches the canonical source, so AskX will not copy it again.
skills.copyCompleted: The Skill was exported and verified.
skills.copyFailed: Skill export failed. The target was preserved or restored to its previous state.
skills.unsavedFileHint: Save or discard the current file changes before switching.
skills.binaryFilePreviewUnsupported: This is a binary file and cannot be previewed online yet.
skills.selectFileDescription: Choose a file from the structure. Text files can be viewed and edited, while binary files show an unsupported-preview notice when selected.
skills.saveFileConfirmDescription: AskX revalidates the manifest, complete Skill and current file fingerprints before saving. Only this managed file changes, and failures restore the original content.
skills.fileSaved: The Skill file was updated and verified.
skills.fileChanged: The Skill or file changed elsewhere. Refresh and edit again.
skills.fileRequestFailed: AskX could not read or update the Skill file. Check the resource state.
skills.canonicalReadyHint: This is the only Skills directory. Each selected Agent's whole Skills root points here through one managed symlink.
skills.canonicalPendingHint: On final save, AskX builds the complete canonical source first, then connects each platform's whole Skills directory one at a time. A failed platform is restored independently; platform directories remain unchanged until then.
skills.clearCanonicalSourceTip: Clear the canonical source without changing platform links. Non-empty content is backed up first.
skills.canonicalBackupManagerDescription: Backups are named by date and that day's sequence. Restore one or permanently delete it; deleted backups cannot be recovered.
skills.noCanonicalBackupsDescription: Clearing a non-empty source creates backup 01. Additional clears on the same day increment the sequence.
skills.clearCanonicalSourceWithBackupDescriptio: AskX first creates and verifies a durable backup, then clears the canonical source and managed Skill records. Platform links stay connected to the now-empty directory.
skills.clearCanonicalSourceEmptyDescription: The canonical source has no files, so AskX will not create an empty backup. It only verifies and clears stale managed Skill records.
skills.restoreCanonicalBackupDescription: This replaces the current canonical source and managed Skill records with the selected version while preserving platform links. Failures restore the pre-operation state.
skills.deleteCanonicalBackupDescription: This permanently removes the selected backup files. AskX cannot recover them afterward, and the current source and platform links are not changed.
skills.canonicalSourcePlanRevalidate: AskX revalidates the manifest, canonical source, and target backup before applying. Any changed state stops safely.
skills.canonicalSourceClearedWithBackup: The canonical source was cleared and its previous content was saved as a durable backup.
skills.canonicalSourceAlreadyEmpty: The canonical source is already empty, so no backup was created.
skills.canonicalBackupRestored: The canonical source backup was restored and platform links were preserved.
skills.canonicalBackupRequestFailed: Could not read canonical source backups. Try again.
skills.canonicalSourceActionFailed: The canonical source or backup changed. Nothing was applied; reopen the action and try again.
skills.suspendPlatformLinkDescription: This only disconnects the platform link and restores the pre-connection Skills directory from its backup as-is. No Skill is scanned, copied, merged, or rewritten. Any failure restores the state from before this operation.
skills.resumePlatformLinkDescription: This only moves the platform's original directory back to its existing backup location and restores the managed link. It does not sync any Skill. Occupied paths stop safely and completed moves are rolled back.
skills.suspendPlatformLinkHint: The pre-connection platform directory is restored; neither it nor the AskX canonical source is rewritten.
skills.resumePlatformLinkHint: The root link is restored and the platform's original directory is kept as-is at its original backup location; no Skill is scanned or synchronized.
skills.platformLinkSuspended: The platform link was disconnected and its pre-connection directory was restored as-is, without synchronizing or modifying any Skill.
skills.platformLinkResumed: The platform link was restored and its original directory was returned to the backup location as-is, without synchronizing or modifying any Skill.
skills.platformLinkActionFailed: The platform link action failed. Check the path state and try again.
skills.deleteCustomLinkTip: Disconnect the link and delete this custom-folder configuration
skills.suspendCustomLinkDescription: This only disconnects the custom-folder link and restores its pre-connection directory as-is. It does not synchronize, delete, or rewrite any Skill. Any failure rolls back to the previous state.
skills.resumeCustomLinkDescription: This moves the pre-connection directory back to its backup location and restores the link to the AskX canonical source. It does not synchronize Skills. Occupied paths stop safely and trigger rollback.
skills.deleteCustomLinkDescription: If the link still exists, AskX first disconnects it safely and restores the pre-connection directory, then removes the link and its manifest binding. Neither the canonical source nor original directory content is deleted.
skills.suspendCustomLinkHint: The pre-connection directory is restored without rewriting it or the canonical source.
skills.resumeCustomLinkHint: Use the canonical source again without scanning or synchronizing Skills.
skills.deleteCustomLinkHint: An active link is disconnected first, then the link configuration is deleted; it cannot be resumed afterward.
skills.customLinkSuspended: The custom-folder link was disconnected and its pre-connection directory was restored as-is.
skills.customLinkResumed: The custom-folder link was restored without synchronizing or modifying any Skill.
skills.customLinkDeleted: The custom-folder link and binding were deleted without changing the canonical source or original directory content.
skills.customLinkActionFailed: The custom-folder link state changed. Nothing was applied; check the paths and try again.
skills.setupEmptyTitle: Skill management is not initialized yet.
skills.setupEmptyDescription: Use Add Skill to choose platform directories or custom folders, review what enters the canonical source, and separately decide whether to connect platform links.
skills.setupDialogDescription: AskX scans platform directories and custom folders read-only, then lets you separately choose platform links. Platforms not explicitly selected are never modified.
skills.transactionDescription: AskX restores from the latest batch first and revalidates the manifest, canonical source and platform root proxies before changing files.
skills.restoreConfirmDescription: Recovery removes the platform root proxies and canonical source created by AskX, then restores each original platform Skills directory from backup as a whole.
skills.restoreBackupHint: If a platform root proxy, canonical source or manifest changed externally, AskX stops recovery and does not overwrite current content.
skills.restoreFailed: Recovery failed. The local state may have changed; scan again and review the receipt.
skills.emptyTitle: The orbit is ready, with no Skills yet.
skills.emptyDescription: AskX remembers your management scope. Add a local Skill and scan again whenever you are ready.
skills.requestFailed: The operation failed. Scan again and retry.
skills.settingsConflict: Settings changed elsewhere. Reload this page.
